example: Example run with fictional figures: Northbrook Trading, Operating account (…4471), September. The figures match the worked examples on the step-by-step page.

messages.text: Can you reconcile our operating account for September?
Yes. Before I read anything, I need six answers. I ask them all at once, so the run does not stop again for each one.
list: Do you want me to use MosoFin, or will you upload files?
Which account? I show account numbers masked.
Which period? I never assume one.
When did you last reconcile this account?
What size of difference is worth chasing?
messages.guard: I read nothing until you answer.

messages.text: Use MosoFin. Operating account ending 4471, September. Statement attached. We reconciled August. Chase anything over $10.

messages.label: Checked the workspace and the company file
messages.summary: The agent can read your books. It cannot change them.

messages.text: Here is my plan for **Operating (…4471), 1 to 30 September**. I will read the books, agree the opening balance, match every statement line and propose entries for what is left. Shall I start?
messages.guard: I propose entries only. I never post them.

messages.label: Read the books in one batch
messages.summary: 9 reads in one batch. Nothing in your books changed.

messages.text: The statement ends at **$12,480.00**. Two items explain the bank side, and both are timing:
messages.after: Nothing in the books needs to change for these two items.

messages.text: Your books say **$12,155.50**. Three statement lines are not in the books, and one payment is in the books twice:

card.title: Book side
rows: − Customer cheque returned, statement line 19 Sep
Difference to the adjusted bank balance

messages.after: Cheque #1031 to Acme Supplies is in the books twice, with the same date, amount and reference.

messages.text: I propose four entries. Each one points to its evidence:

card.title: Proposed entries
head: Entry
Amount
Evidence
rows: Reverse the returned cheque to what the customer owes

messages.after: The $300 goes back to what the customer owes. It is not an expense. Please also chase the customer.
messages.guard: A person posts these entries. I do not.

messages.text: The reconciliation ties to the cent. Your report has the summary, the matched and open items, the exceptions, the proposed entries and the coverage.
messages.after: Do you want me to save your settings for next month?

messages.text: Done. I saved your policy choices and names only. Next month, the run starts from them.
messages.guard: I save settings only after the results, and only when you say yes.
